audience: business owners and front-desk staff who run waitlists and bookings with Waitwhile

useCases.title: See who is waiting and the current wait time
useCases.text: The AI reads the live status of locations with open or closed state, people waiting and being served, and the estimated wait. It can also list the visits in line.

useCases.title: Review today's bookings and find a visit
useCases.text: The AI lists visits (waitlist entries and bookings) and can search by customer name, phone, email or customer id, filtered by location, state or tag.

useCases.title: Find the first open appointment slots
useCases.text: The AI lists booking slots for a location and date range, or the first available slots from a date, optionally for a party size, services and resources. You can propose times to a customer.

useCases.title: Report visits, bookings and no-shows for a period
useCases.text: The AI reads visit statistics for a period: visits, waitlisted, bookings, served, no-shows, cancellations and wait durations, with breakdowns by location, resource and service.

useCases.title: Add, update or cancel a visit, or add a customer note
useCases.text: The AI adds a customer to the waitlist or creates a booking, changes a visit's state, tags or time, cancels a visit, or adds a staff note to a customer.
